Security Engineer
Fairview Bank - Omaha, NE

Fairview Bank's security team watches 120 branches and the online bank around the clock. This
role writes detections, tunes the SIEM and runs the bank's phishing program.

Requirements
- CISSP certification
- 3+ years in a security operations or SOC role
- Writing detection rules in Splunk or another SIEM

Preferred
- Running phishing simulations and security awareness training
- EDR tools such as CrowdStrike

Hybrid, three days a week in the Omaha office. Pension and paid certification renewals.
